entries.mem0ai/mem0: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that offers a universal memory layer for AI Agents. It supports multi-level memory for User, Session, and Agent states through temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that delivers memory, RAG, and user profiles via a single API. It features a custom vector graph engine and supports multi-modal extraction for code, images, videos, and PDFs.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that utilizes the viking:// protocol for context management. It employs tiered L0/L1/L2 loading to reduce token spend and provides observable retrieval trajectories for debugging.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: An opinionated brain for Hermes Agents that creates typed edges for a self-wiring knowledge graph. It provides synthesized answers featuring citations and gap analysis.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A memory system designed for long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows. It is available via Python and Node.js client SDKs and supports Docker-based deployment.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A memory library for building stateful agents that supports peer-centric modeling and background reasoning. It is available as a managed service or a self-hosted FastAPI server with Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages context trees using git-like version control. It features a 5-tier retrieval system and an interactive TUI/REPL interface.
entries.AxDSan/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system that utilizes a single SQLite database for sub-millisecond performance. It supports episodic compression for storage savings and MCP via stdio or SSE.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness that provides filesystem-first traces, reports, and datasets. It supports multiple agent providers, including MCP clients and Pi.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a DAG-based context engine to prevent message loss. It utilizes a SQLite message store with FTS metadata and builds depth-aware summary nodes.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted backend for Honcho that enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider.
entries.plur-ai/plur: A shared memory layer for multi-agent systems that utilizes an open engram YAML format. It supports Hermes and provides local-first, zero-cost search.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first layer manages identity, memory, and secrets to provide portable state across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and MCP clients. It includes a dashboard and tools for inspecting, editing, and repairing memory.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: An on-device context engine that utilizes hybrid retrieval via BM25 and vector search without cloud dependencies. It integrates through MCP and Claude Code hooks, using a local GGUF observer model to capture decisions.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool reduces prefill latency and token usage through block reordering and deduplication for prefix reuse. It features native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: A durable, file-based memory system that uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is distributed as a five-package plugin family including an SDK, CLI, and Hermes adapter.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by attaching a why_retrieved tag to every recall. It supports embedded in-process mode or an HTTP backend and tracks contradictions via conflict and resolution primitives.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: An anticipatory memory system that prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs. It uses SQLite-vec and GGUF models via node-llama-cpp and functions as an MCP-native server.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: A memory kernel stack that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide evidence packets to the agent.
entries.keepnotes-ai/keep: This reflective memory system uses semantic search with BM25 and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for codebases, URLs, and multimedia with OCR support and bidirectional edge tags.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This tool reduces prompt token overhead for Hermes Agent v0.14.0 through local BM25 tool ranking. It includes a dashboard to track estimated schema token savings and supports native tool search.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This layer resolves live workspace state into verified facts to minimize prompt tokens before the context window opens. It implements the Model Context Protocol and supports encrypted persistent memory via the Perseus Vault.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: A daemonless, long-term memory solution that stores data as inspectable Markdown files. It uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache and supports Claude Code and Codex.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: A local-only plugin that uses a single.lbdb embedded graph database for storage. It features importance-weighted recall, BM25 keyword search, and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This plugin implements a pull-model episodic memory with an on-demand summarizer and immediate event deletion. It includes a trace.jsonl audit log to track every memory operation.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables durable cross-session AI memory through semantic search. It mirrors native Hermes memory writes to XMemo and supports session snapshots and working state storage.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables API charging via USDC and stablecoins across multiple chain families, including EVM and Solana. It integrates with Hermes to facilitate agent payments.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term agent memory. It features tools for manual memory storage and configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This reusable plugin provides tools for searching, fetching, and traversing local artifact graphs. It includes automatic generation of tool-routing knowledge via OKFs and supports proactive routing.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories, supporting semantic and literal code search. It runs locally over localhost and provides grounded Q&A with file-and-line citations.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native long-term memory features AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and exact-text recall. It also includes MinHash for near-duplicate detection.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal. It utilizes hybrid search combining BM25, vector, and graph methods alongside automatic context checkpointing.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework provides an agentic skills methodology for software development, including capabilities for testing, debugging, and collaboration. It supports various harnesses such as Claude Code and Cursor through a subagent-driven-development process.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first open-source prototyping system that supports HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4 exports. It is compatible with local CLI executables and various coding agents, including Hermes Agent.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library contains 817 production-grade skills across 29 security domains, mapped to six major frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0. These structured cybersecurity skills are compatible with 26+ AI platforms and Hermes Agent.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool converts Mermaid text into editable.drawio files and supports 11 diagram type presets. It features self-check and auto-fix capabilities to generate diagrams from natural language descriptions.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This utility audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI writing patterns using 57 pattern categories. It is compatible with Hermes, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenClaw through Rewrite, Detect, and Edit modes.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project enables collective skill evolution for shared user teams through an Agentic Evolver. It provides automated skill deduplication, quality improvement, and unified skill libraries across multiple agents and devices.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library compatible with Claude Code and agentskills.io-compatible agents. It includes 12 metaskills designed for guided business and code journeys.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: This skill acts as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, providing adjudication for deals through escrow and dispute resolution. It includes a master router, connector skills, and vendored copies of official protocol skills.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin automatically detects and proposes reusable skills from active workflows. It generates Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation, offering slash commands to manage and save detected patterns.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This set of skills enables video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction for Hermes Agent and other compatible agents. It extracts transcripts, captions, and timestamps without the use of yt-dlp.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI using modular packages of instructions, resources, and scripts. It implements progressive disclosure for prompt efficiency and supports remote registries.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This skill set enables the dynamic generation of custom analytical lenses via the /prism-scan command. It includes seven pre-built prisms and a /prism-reflect command to identify analysis blind spots through constraint reporting.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents through Lite and Full modes. It includes a spec review gate utilizing PASS/FAIL evaluation models to ensure quality during the transition from idea to handoff.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro serves as a harness for long-running AI agents using a three-level work model. It provides structured memory via file-backed or SQLite-backed cards and includes a CLI for managing tasks and cards.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill enables literate programming by weaving code and documentation into.lit.md files containing prose, diagrams, and source code. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the literate document.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates self-memory and model replacement by using markdown files for cross-instance shared memory. It automates the capture of high-value decisions and outcomes to create a pipeline for fine-tuning replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These skills provide integration for CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds following the AgentSkills specification. They include specialized skills for CRE and ACE services to enable oracle network and smart contract interaction.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This project provides standardized prompting guidelines for the FLUX.1 and FLUX.2 model families. It includes API integration patterns for webhooks, polling, and error handling, alongside support for JSON structured prompting.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool generates version-pinned instruction files by converting repositories, documentation URLs, or developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It ensures provenance through the use of documentation URLs or file:line citations.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: Skilldock.io acts as a registry for reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification. It supports skill installation with recursive dependency resolution and provides a Python SkilldockClient and a CLI.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution for long-running, multi-step tasks. It features real-time tracking of decisions and progress, alongside built-in rollback procedures for safe recovery.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This skill implements a progressive MCP client using a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage. It utilizes a socket-based daemon architecture for persistent connections and incremental discovery of tool schemas.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a single Rust binary that functions as a workflow language for AI. It features static auditing for types, permissions, and cost, and produces hash-chained, tamper-evident execution receipts.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill manages Nextcloud files, notes, tasks, calendars, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV. It communicates securely over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for configuration.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This skill utilizes a five-layer retrieval system involving hard triggers, FTS5, synonyms, dense embeddings, and RRF fusion. It reduces token usage by narrowing skill lists before LLM calls and features graceful degradation if dependencies are missing.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This tool performs adversarial bug-hunting code reviews using three parallel subagents to analyze edge cases, exploitability, and integration risks. It operates in a read-only capacity and uses a feedback MCP server to generate suppression rules for false positives.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across various surfaces including CLI, TUI, Discord, and Telegram. It tailors rewrites to specific model families and preserves non-English prompts using langid or Unicode-range heuristics.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# /.NET implementation of agentskills.io features MCP integration and tool-based skill loading via Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports automatic registration of common agent skill directories and implements progressive disclosure through SKILL.md files.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: This skill employs a three-agent swarm targeting hygiene, structural clarity, and logic correctness through a risk-tiered triage system. It includes language-specific detection for concurrency anti-patterns and N+1 queries.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It provides a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and uses a Python goal engine for persistent task state management.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: This hub facilitates community skill browsing, search, and one-click installation following the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It features federated search integration with GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server allows users to search over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and integrates with MCP-compatible clients.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC. It supports Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols and is compatible with the agentskills.io standard.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates structured Chinese news reports ranging from global to street-level scales. It includes quality gates, AI analysis, and integrates user interests via semantic memory for search expansion.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes. It includes tools for terminal-based development and features packages that are updated daily.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository contains scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, such as Hermes Agent, on Android smartphones via Termux. It features an automated installer for Antigravity CLI on ARM64 and provides configuration guides for running OpenClaw using Termux:API and Termux:GUI.
entries.rookiemann/portable-hermes-agent: This is a zero-install desktop GUI for Windows that requires no admin rights. It features an integrated workflow engine for automated multi-step pipelines and includes an extensive toolset including TTS, Music, and ComfyUI.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This project offers an automated Termux-based installer and guide for running Hermes Agent on Android devices. It supports local model execution via Ollama and is compatible with providers such as OpenAI and Anthropic.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This unofficial community Helm chart enables deployment on Kubernetes with cloud-native state-safety guardrails. It enforces single-writer state safety for persistent HERMES_HOME storage and supports configurable gateway mode with optional API and webhook listeners.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project provides Hermes Agent sandboxing through hardware-level enforcement via NVIDIA OpenShell. It utilizes kernel-level restrictions for network and filesystem access and allows for configurable security policies for messaging and web search.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a simple Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state via mounted home directories and allows for building specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible Hermes deployment through declarative configuration. It supports hybrid skill management and secure secrets integration via systemd EnvironmentFiles and sops-nix.
entries.solomon2773/nora: This self-hosted control plane is designed to deploy, monitor, and operate OpenClaw and Hermes AI agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps via a REST API, CLI, and MCP.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: This Docker-first control plane orchestrates multiple Hermes Agent instances from a single web application. It manages separate workspaces and identities, provides hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation, and offers enterprise MCP access.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It enables autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and includes Nous Portal integration.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes multiple LLM providers or local Ollama models to power fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical analysts. It employs structured-output agents to facilitate financial trading decision making.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: An orchestration platform that supports workflows across CrewAI, LangGraph, AutoGen, and other agents. It provides a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API to monitor spend, track tasks, and manage scheduling.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: A control surface providing TUI, web, and CLI interfaces for managing various coding agents, including Claude Code and Gemini. It offers optional sandboxing via Docker, Podman, or Apple containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: A template featuring a tiered architecture and task bus pattern to scale from single agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for VPS setup, security auditing, and registry management.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a level-based architecture and task bus pattern to scale Hermes Agent from single agents to automated teams. It provides bundled skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: A tool for building autonomous agent swarms that supports over 23 LLM providers, including OpenAI and Ollama. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.Agent-3-7/minions: A mission control interface that uses a Kanban board and review queues to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution alongside human-in-the-loop verification.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized agents for research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing and coordination.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: A local collaboration system that orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: A meta-optimization harness designed to automate the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: An agent-vs-agent arena where nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies compete for GitHub stars. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and features a real-time dashboard for scoreboard metrics.
entries.Rainhoole/hermes-agent-acp-skill: An ACP-style delegation system that routes tasks between Hermes subagents, Codex, and Claude Code. It prevents parent context pollution through isolated workflows and enforces safety via timeouts and output character limits.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, pre-indexed code knowledge graph powered by a Rust kernel to reduce token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent. It supports Windows, macOS, and Linux and features automatic project synchronization.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: This cross-platform CLI tool features a native Rust TUI for tracking token usage across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes. It monitors usage for various models such as Claude Code, OpenClaw, and Gemini.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows for the inspection of coding-agent API traffic from Hermes Agent and other tools like Cursor and Claude Code. It provides exportable HTML trace sessions and redacts common auth headers during recording.
entries.bergside/typeui: This tool provides design systems and layout guidance via MCP servers to assist in building UIs with AI. It is compatible with any AI provider supporting markdown or general prompting and integrates with Hermes Agent.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents to assist in building, shipping, and operating applications with Hermes Agent. It includes 36 skills and 6 workflows for autonomous execution on laptops or a VPS.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This CLI tool allows users to customize the Hermes terminal UI with various themes, such as cyberpunk or retro DOS aesthetics. It supports YAML-based configuration for customizing banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform facilitates a social economy for autonomous AI agents using encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via the Signal Protocol. It supports identity registration with human-readable @handles and commerce via Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project is a port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel. It runs natively within Claude Code without external processes or OAuth and includes MLOps tools for RL training and inference.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: This AI-native browser is designed for autonomous agent control via MCP and features a visible UI for real-time supervision. It includes session management and an integrated research desk.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings through specialized CLI workflows. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills for research, devops, and finance on macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This TAW Agent framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents using per-folder local configuration and skills. It allows for seamless switching between default and scoped agents while supporting project-local memories and tools.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool provides automated installation for the hermes-agent stack and over 12 supporting services. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.roli-lpci/lintlang: This static linter validates AI agent configurations, tool descriptions, and system prompts using regex and structural heuristics. It supports JSON, YAML, plain text, Markdown, and.prompt files without requiring model or API calls, and includes HERM v1.1 scoring.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration tool facilitates the transition from OpenClaw to Hermes Agent by transferring SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives. It maps OpenClaw configurations and credentials into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats while setting up systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: This observability tool provides self-healing capabilities for multi-agent systems through automated operational and functional health monitoring. It features a beta Hermes plugin for exporting telemetry for API requests and tool calls, alongside token intelligence tracking for cost estimation and memory bloat.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: A cross-platform manager built with Tauri 2 that supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It provides a unified interface for managing multiple agentic tools and CLI models, including Hermes Agent.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: An open-source cowork application that supports various agent CLIs, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It features built-in assistants for Word, Excel, and PPT, and enables remote access via WebUI, Telegram, Lark, DingTalk, and WeChat.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: A Python and vanilla JavaScript web interface designed for use on web browsers or mobile devices. It offers a three-panel layout featuring chat and workspace file browsing, providing full parity with the Hermes CLI experience.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion application designed for installing and configuring Hermes Agent. It provides a GUI for managing sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-web-ui: A web dashboard that includes a file browser, web terminal, and usage analytics. It supports local SQLite session storage and provides unified configuration for channels like Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A native web workspace featuring an integrated memory browser, skills manager, and MCP catalog. It includes a Monaco editor, PTY terminal, and Swarm Mode with tmux-backed workers.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native Mac workspace that connects to Hermes hosts via local or SSH connections. It provides dedicated views for sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs, alongside an embedded terminal for shell access.
entries.Eynzof/hermes-agent-cn-desktop: A desktop application built with Tauri, Rust, and TypeScript for Windows and macOS. It includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core runtime.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: A Chromium side-panel extension for Chrome, Edge, and Chromium that connects active browser contexts to local, cloud, or remote Hermes Agent runtimes. It includes Hermes Web for full-page workspace sessions.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted web dashboard that provides real-time chat with tool call visualization and a browser-based terminal. It includes an MCP server control plane and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS application that serves as a session browser and agent cockpit. It tracks live per-session quota burn-rates and operates locally with no telemetry or remote logging.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: A native macOS workspace designed for Hermes Agent running on SSH hosts or Orgo cloud computers. It features one-click automated installation on fresh cloud computers and integrated WebRTC voice mode.
entries.liftaris/herm: This OpenTUI-based terminal dashboard consolidates Hermes Agent chat, sessions, and configuration into a single interface. It features integrated kanban boards for task and diagnostic management alongside an extensible Eikon avatar system.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A React-based mobile-first SPA designed for Telegram Mini App v2.0 that runs locally. It supports terminal chat with streaming responses and file attachments, while allowing for five concurrent background agent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A no-install Windows desktop application that requires no admin rights or Docker. It provides a GUI for managing 100 tools—including TTS, Music, and ComfyUI—and includes a workflow engine for scheduled automation pipelines.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface designed for self-hosted AI assistance. It provides real-time log streaming, a file browser, and management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This dashboard provides real-time monitoring of session activity and cost tracking. It allows for full inspection of conversation histories, skill source code, and read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted workspace featuring a chat-first interface with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for sessions and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A native desktop client that orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 curated installations and supports streaming SSE responses and model switching.
